title: Bounds on the visited interval
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $t\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $i$ be a work tape of $M$. The leftmost head position visited through time $t$ is at most zero, zero is at most the rightmost visited position, the head position at time $t$ lies between these bounds, and the bounds satisfy $-t\le \mathrm{leftmost}\le 0\le \mathrm{rightmost}\le t$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
replaced:
For every machine $M$, input $x$, time $t$, and work tape $i$: the leftmost visited
position is at most zero, the rightmost is at least zero, the current head at time $t$
lies between them, and they lie within $[-t, t]$, so the visited interval has width at
most $2t + 1$.
